name: EirEnvelope
title: Eir envelope
description: Eir's workflow fields for a record, as JSON: the Eir record kind, the data Eir wrote (author, status, encounter link and similar), the time Eir first created the record, a revision counter and an optional idempotency key. The native FHIR elements of the resource are canonical for clinical content; this extension preserves the exact representation Eir wrote and the workflow fields FHIR has no element for. Readers that do not know Eir can ignore it.

element.definition: JSON document with the fields eir (format version), kind, data, createdAt, rev and optionally origin.
